meta.source: MLB Stats API season pitching splits
meta.def_adjustment: Statcast team OAA at 0.8 runs/out, allocated by BIP share
meta.method: Simplified two-pole WAR: FIP-based pole (~fWAR philosophy) and RA9-based pole with a bWAR-style team-defense adjustment (war_ra9_adj; war_ra9 is unadjusted). No park factors, static runs-per-win. WAR at any blend = lerp(war_fip, war_ra9_adj, lambda).
